decisions.title: Jarvis is a system service, not an app
decisions.status: Built and running on the emulator. Not yet on a phone. The `jarvisos-ax` skill names a plan (TASK_2) to move inference and agent logic out of `system_server`; that plan is not written down in the repo yet.

decisions.title: Apps talk to Jarvis over Binder, not HTTP
The tool description is separate from how the tool is called
App tools are broadcast receivers; built-in tools run inside Jarvis
Only trusted callers may ask Jarvis to act
decisions.status: Built. `jarvis_session` needs no permission, by design: any app may open a session, but only for its own declared session and only while in the foreground (decision 10).

decisions.title: One door to the models, two engines behind it
decisions.status: Both built. Cactus builds for x86_64 through a SIMDe shim (22 Oct) but `auto` never picks it there. The emulator uses llama.cpp with Qwen3 1.7B. On a phone, `auto` prefers Cactus.

decisions.title: A small model answers first (the fast path)
decisions.status: Built, with one open problem (roadblock 35): Needle always names a tool, and its confidence scores that guess, not whether the request is a command at all. "How are you doing today" scored 0.80 and read the notifications. Not fixed yet. The 2 Oct Cactus notes warned that the demo model could quietly become the architecture; Needle is now in the request path, so that warning applies.

decisions.title: The agent loop stops after five turns
ObjectBox never stores embeddings
decisions.status: The rule holds. Two follow-ups from the 2 Oct storage notes are not done: index IDs are still stored as engine IDs, not JarvisOS-owned IDs with a mapping, and ObjectBox is used directly in about 58 places outside `core/` and `model/` instead of behind one storage layer.

decisions.title: In a session, apps send data, never prompts
decisions.status: Built (emulator). One gap: the manifest's `rules` and `persona` are app-written text that goes into the system prompt (`SessionPrompt.java`, lines 69 to 71). So "never prompts" is true for events, not for the manifest.

decisions.title: One fence on the one route every tool call takes
decisions.status: Built. The fence scopes by session, not by risk: outside a session, every non-session tool can run.

decisions.title: Raw history lasts a day; learned facts stay
decisions.status: Built. Tool results are kept as summaries of at most 600 characters.

decisions.title: Nothing in system_server opens the network
decisions.status: Built for Cactus. Check any new native library for network use before adding it.

decisions.title: Dangerous tools ask first (partly built)
decisions.status: Partial. Only `make_phone_call` sets it; `send_sms` runs without asking. There is no way yet to confirm and then run (the code notes this as "Phase 7"). The `jarvisos-ax` ERD replaces this flag with `sideEffect` on the tool and a `GRANT` with `always`, `ask` or `never`.

decisions.title: One shared build server, one way in (`jh`)
decisions.status: Built (28 to 29 Oct 2026). Open: the disk is at 92 % and more storage has been asked of Hetzner; attribution is the `Server-user` trailer, which root can still fake.
